messages:
carmen: FYI team — rolling out a brief maintenance + tail-latency focused load test next week. Please ack if this conflicts with any promos.

carmen: Change summary:
- SLO adjustment: we'll temporarily tighten p99 target check to 800ms for canary pools during the test window to validate routing and kernel affinity changes.
- Why: recent workloads exposed rare p99 spikes when KV-cache cold starts align with long-context requests. This test verifies mitigations.

reza: When's the window?

carmen: Fri Apr 16 2026 03:30-04:30 UTC. Scope: us-west-2 canaries + one eu canary region. Controlled fanout + simulated AZ drain. No expected user downtime; canary latencies may exceed SLO briefly.

nina: Monitoring plan: temp dashboard w/ p50/p95/p99, kv-cache miss-rate, model queue length, and routing fallback counts. Pager if p99 > 1s for 5m or 5xx > 10% for 3m.

devrel: I'll prep a short blurb for release channels advising teams to avoid promotions between 02:30-05:00 UTC that day.

carmen: Runbook links and abort snippets:
```
# stop fanout
kubectl scale deploy/loadtest -n stress --replicas=0
# isolate canary routing
infractl routing set-weight --pool canary --weight 0
# revert affinity changes
infractl runtime affinity revert --tag canary
```

ops-bot: Calendar event: "Tail-latency test + maintenance" Fri Apr 16 03:30-04:30 UTC 1 invites: #eng-sre #eng-runtime #product-ops

reza: Ack 1 I'll be on rotation and can join the incident channel if it fires.

nina: :eyes: will post dashboard link 30m prior.

carmen: Thanks. React with :white_check_mark: once read.
